description: core's runtime save corpus (conformance/saves/runtime-save.json, PL.core-load-refused-message and PL.core-load-refusal-codes) through the save.runtime.* rows, each run the calls core's reference runner (src/runtime-save-corpus.ts) makes, through them: create, then one apply per step; numbers held exactly (tests/runtime_save_corpus.cpp replays the file itself within its tolerance, 1e-9).

cases.name: saves-runtime: the contract save.runtime.contract states

expect.refusedLoadMessage: Unrecognized save format — this slot cannot be loaded.

cases.name: saves-runtime run: the runtime save starts as the fresh document
saves-runtime run: New Game at the start keeps the fresh document
saves-runtime run: Load, then New Game: the runtime save is the fresh document again, not the loaded one
saves-runtime run: Load, then New Game, then Save: the new game's first save carries nothing of the loaded one
saves-runtime run: New Game at the start, then Save: the fresh document with the new game's state
saves-runtime run: Load, then Save, with no New Game: the save writes into the loaded document
saves-runtime run: Save, then New Game: the game's own save is not carried either
saves-runtime run: Load, Load again, then New Game: the fresh document, whichever save was loaded last
saves-runtime run: a Load refused wrong_version shows core's invalid_format message and leaves the runtime save as it was
